name: More storage (rclone)
description: Keeps encrypted copies of your COGNIX[WS] backups in Dropbox, OneDrive, an SFTP server or WebDAV (Nextcloud, ownCloud), through rclone. COGNIX[WS] encrypts everything before it leaves this computer; the storage never sees what is inside.
